notes: No official public API to search the Play Store catalogue or read other developers' listings: the Google Play Developer API (androidpublisher) is for publishing and management tasks 'similar to those available to a developer through the Play Console' (store listings, releases, products, purchases).

Its Reply to Reviews API is keyed to a package name and 'allows you to view user feedback for your app'. Only reviews created or modified in the last week that have text; 200 GET per hour per app. It is usable only for apps in the caller's own Play Console.
Neither page lists a catalogue-search API (checked 2026-11-27).
Scraping play.google.com is excluded by the project rules (no scraping that bypasses terms). Third-party scraper libraries and paid data vendors are not used without a Product Owner decision.

limitations: Manual only: the user can paste a Play Store URL as a note on a competitor; App Spy does not fetch it.
Options for the Product Owner: a licensed data vendor (for example data.ai/Sensor Tower: paid, contract), or limit App Spy to iOS.
